method: Design FMEA: Severity/Occurrence/Detection each scored 1..10; RPN = S*O*D. Scores are engineering estimates and must be revised from field/runtime evidence.

review_policy.cadence: review on every architecture milestone, after any tunnel/routing incident, and before every release tag
review_policy.release_rule: no unresolved risk at or above the high-RPN threshold or critical-severity threshold; explicit accepted risks require acceptance_reason

risks.title: Partial Agent Tunnel startup leaves stale route/nftables state
risks.failure_mode: sing-box changes part of TUN/routing state and startup then fails
risks.effect: host connectivity degradation or traffic routed differently after AntigravitiProxi reports failure
risks.cause: multi-step non-transactional OS networking changes
risks.mitigation: add startup transaction/rollback watchdog, route-state fingerprint and stale-state recovery
risks.verification: fault-injection tests must fail each startup phase and prove route/TUN/nftables state returns to baseline

risks.title: Antigravity helper is not attributed and bypasses selected VPN
risks.failure_mode: new or renamed IDE helper does not match process_name/process_path rules
risks.effect: agent generation uses an unintended egress and can fail geo/eligibility checks
risks.cause: Antigravity is multi-process and helper topology can change between IDE releases
controls: Linux dual-egress CI probes for Antigravity/language_server/bundled helper
risks.mitigation: add production PID-tree discovery, runtime egress attestation and learned helper endpoint/process policy
risks.verification: runtime must prove each discovered agent PID uses selected egress; unknown helper must degrade health instead of silently bypassing

risks.title: Domain fallback captures unrelated Google traffic
risks.failure_mode: domain-only fallback sends unrelated processes contacting googleapis.com through vpn-direct
risks.effect: process-isolation invariant is weakened and unrelated applications can change network path
risks.cause: fallback is intentionally broader than process matching to catch unknown helpers
risks.mitigation: replace broad domain fallback with learned PID/path plus narrowly scoped endpoint policy; surface scope bleed in health UI
risks.verification: negative integration tests for non-Antigravity Google clients must retain system-direct egress

risks.title: VPN interface recreation invalidates bind_interface
risks.failure_mode: VPN reconnect creates a new interface/index or makes the configured interface temporarily unavailable
risks.effect: Agent Tunnel stops working or remains degraded until manually reconfigured
risks.cause: desktop VPN clients frequently recreate TUN/WireGuard interfaces
controls: preflight checks selected interface exists and is UP
risks.mitigation: watch interface lifecycle and re-resolve/rebind selected VPN using stable identity plus route probes
risks.verification: integration test disconnects/recreates VPN interface and proves automatic degraded->healthy recovery

risks.title: IPv6 or DNS path leaks outside intended egress
risks.failure_mode: IPv4 follows vpn-direct while IPv6 or resolver traffic follows another path
risks.effect: inconsistent geolocation, DNS poisoning exposure or backend failure
risks.cause: dual-stack OS routing and resolver behavior differ across platforms/distributions
risks.mitigation: separate IPv4/IPv6 health and egress verification; explicitly test DNS and QUIC/UDP paths
risks.verification: dual-stack integration matrix must prove A/AAAA DNS and TCP/UDP egress use the selected policy

risks.title: Privileged networking and desktop control plane are insufficiently separated
risks.failure_mode: whole application is elevated to obtain TUN privileges
risks.effect: larger privileged attack surface and risk of root/admin-owned desktop state
risks.cause: MVP starts sing-box directly from the UI/control-plane process
controls: Linux launch guard drops IDE back to invoking user
risks.mitigation: introduce minimal privileged helper: UAC helper on Windows and pkexec/capability-scoped helper on Linux
risks.verification: desktop control plane and IDE run unprivileged while only helper can mutate TUN/routes

risks.title: sing-box schema or supply-chain drift breaks networking
risks.failure_mode: future sing-box release changes schema/behavior or downloaded artifact is not trustworthy
risks.effect: startup failure or changed routing semantics
risks.cause: external privileged dependency
controls: real sing-box config check in CI
risks.mitigation: fail closed when digest is absent, add compatibility contract before version upgrades and provenance/SBOM on release
risks.verification: dependency upgrade PR must pass schema+runtime matrix and signature/digest policy

risks.title: Local control plane can be exposed beyond loopback by configuration
risks.failure_mode: listen address is changed from loopback to a LAN/public interface
risks.effect: remote callers can reach privileged actions; CSRF is not a substitute for network isolation
risks.cause: listen address is configurable and loopback is currently a convention rather than enforced invariant
risks.mitigation: enforce loopback-only control-plane binding unless a separately authenticated remote-control mode is explicitly designed
risks.verification: config tests reject wildcard/non-loopback listen addresses

risks.title: Emergency hosts override becomes stale
risks.failure_mode: temporary Google IP remains pinned after topology/backend changes
risks.effect: future connectivity/TLS failures unrelated to active proxy mode
risks.cause: hosts entries have no TTL and survive process restart
risks.mitigation: record ownership/expiry metadata and warn or auto-remove stale override at startup
risks.verification: restart/time-shift tests prove expired override is detected and safely removed

risks.title: Power loss or external kill leaves orphan network state
risks.failure_mode: SIGKILL, kernel crash or power loss prevents graceful sing-box cleanup
risks.effect: stale TUN, policy routing or firewall state at next launch
risks.cause: process cleanup cannot run after non-cooperative termination
risks.mitigation: startup stale-state detector with ownership markers and deterministic recovery
risks.verification: kill -9/reboot simulation detects prior state and restores baseline before enabling a new tunnel

risks.title: Backend/account eligibility failure is misclassified as transport failure
risks.failure_mode: FAILED_PRECONDITION/PERMISSION_DENIED is treated as a routing problem
risks.effect: user repeatedly escalates networking changes that cannot fix server-side eligibility
risks.cause: UI-level agent error is generic and multiple root causes share the same message
risks.mitigation: make backend-vs-transport classification a first-class health dimension and stop escalation on explicit server-side eligibility rejection
risks.verification: fixture logs for geo/account, quota, MCP, auth and 5xx must produce deterministic next actions

risks.title: Managed sing-box update removes Linux file capabilities
risks.failure_mode: managed binary is replaced during update and loses CAP_NET_ADMIN/CAP_NET_RAW xattrs
risks.effect: Agent Tunnel unexpectedly stops starting after an otherwise successful update
risks.cause: file capabilities belong to the replaced inode
risks.mitigation: detect capability loss after install/update and provide privileged helper to reapply only required capabilities
risks.verification: upgrade test starts with capabilities, replaces binary, repairs capabilities and proves tunnel can start unprivileged

risks.title: TUN policy conflicts with Docker, VM or NetworkManager routes
risks.failure_mode: auto_route/auto_redirect overlaps another routing/firewall manager
risks.effect: unrelated workloads lose connectivity or tunnel startup fails
risks.cause: desktop hosts have heterogeneous policy routing, nftables and virtual interfaces
risks.mitigation: snapshot route/rule/nft state, detect conflicts before apply, and add distro/Docker/VM integration matrix
risks.verification: runtime matrix with Docker bridge, libvirt/VirtualBox equivalents and NetworkManager preserves unrelated connectivity

risks.title: Mixed proxy port health masks a broken TUN or route
risks.failure_mode: 127.0.0.1:7890 accepts connections while TUN/process routing/DNS is unhealthy
risks.effect: UI reports success even though agent execution still uses wrong path
risks.cause: Running() currently tests only the mixed listener
risks.mitigation: replace boolean running state with health state machine and independent mixed/tun/route/dns/egress/backend dimensions
risks.verification: fault injection must independently break each dimension and UI/API must report degraded state accurately

risks.title: Selected egress invariant is not continuously verified on the real host
risks.failure_mode: configuration looks correct but actual source interface/public egress differs
risks.effect: geo-sensitive backend sees the wrong network despite green local status
risks.cause: static config validation cannot prove kernel/runtime egress
controls: Linux CI dual-egress test proves process/path policy and negative isolation
risks.mitigation: add safe production egress attestation for discovered Antigravity PID tree and selected VPN without exposing user traffic content
risks.verification: health report records expected interface and observed egress for agent probes; mismatch blocks healthy state

risks.title: Shutdown timeout or SIGKILL prevents deterministic cleanup
risks.failure_mode: sing-box ignores SIGTERM and forced termination happens before cleanup
risks.effect: network state can remain until OS reconciliation or next recovery
risks.cause: bounded shutdown must eventually force-kill a stuck helper
risks.mitigation: persist pre-change state fingerprint and recover on next start even after forced termination
risks.verification: forced-timeout test proves next launch detects and repairs residual state

risks.title: main branch is not protected by required CI checks
risks.failure_mode: a direct push can land without successful test/risk gates
risks.effect: networking regressions can reach main despite strong CI definitions
risks.cause: repository branch protection is currently disabled
risks.mitigation: enable main branch protection and require test, linux-tun-runtime, riskcheck and build checks
risks.verification: GitHub branch rules reject a merge/push path that lacks required successful checks
plan_refs: P1 protect main with required status checks

risks.title: Linux runtime portability is under-tested outside Ubuntu amd64
risks.failure_mode: ARM64 or another distro differs in nftables, capabilities, resolver or packaging behavior
risks.effect: build succeeds but Agent Tunnel fails at runtime
risks.cause: privileged CI currently runs only Ubuntu amd64
risks.mitigation: add Debian/Fedora-family runtime matrix and native/virtual ARM64 privileged runner
risks.verification: same TUN lifecycle and dual-egress assertions pass on each supported runtime target

risks.title: Diagnostics can disclose tokens, IPs or user paths
risks.failure_mode: support bundle contains sensitive authentication/network/local-path information
risks.effect: credential or privacy exposure when report is shared
risks.cause: logs originate from multiple external/internal components with inconsistent formats
controls: Agent Doctor redacts detected bearer/OAuth token values
risks.mitigation: central redaction pipeline for tokens, cookies, emails, user paths and optional IP anonymization before export
risks.verification: fixture corpus with synthetic secrets must produce zero unredacted matches in exported bundle

risks.title: Static Antigravity backend endpoint list drifts
risks.failure_mode: Google adds or changes agent/model backend hostname and it is not in current policy
risks.effect: new agent flow bypasses intended DNS/egress routing or fails
risks.cause: backend topology is controlled externally and can evolve independently
risks.mitigation: learn backend hostnames from language-server command line, SNI and logs, then require review before persisting policy
risks.verification: fixture/new-host test demonstrates unknown agent endpoint is surfaced and routed according to learned process policy

risks.title: Settings/UI contract drifts from tunnel orchestration
risks.failure_mode: a visible setting is persisted but ignored by StartAgentTunnel or another action
risks.effect: operator believes a safety/routing option is active when runtime uses defaults
risks.cause: settings, web UI and orchestration are manually wired without contract tests
risks.mitigation: make tunnel options derive from one validated config object and add API->runtime contract tests for every setting
risks.verification: each UI/config field changes generated runtime config or is rejected as unsupported
plan_refs: P1 single validated tunnel options object

risks.title: Local proxy port collision creates false-positive health
risks.failure_mode: another process is listening on configured mixed port while managed sing-box is absent or failed
risks.effect: Running() reports healthy and Antigravity can be launched through an unintended local service
risks.cause: current listener health check validates reachability, not PID/protocol/ownership
controls: manager separately tracks child process when it started sing-box
risks.mitigation: verify listener PID belongs to managed sing-box and perform authenticated/protocol health handshake before launch
risks.verification: occupy port with fake service; health must be failed and launch blocked

risks.title: Installer accepts release asset when digest metadata is absent
risks.failure_mode: download succeeds but release API provides no digest and installer continues after a warning
risks.effect: privileged binary authenticity is weaker than intended
risks.cause: MVP availability fallback is fail-open
controls: digest is normally checked when present
risks.mitigation: fail closed when expected digest is absent and optionally pin a repository-maintained allowlist for emergency offline verification
risks.verification: installer test with empty digest must refuse installation

risks.title: Configuration writes are not atomic
risks.failure_mode: process or machine crashes during direct WriteFile replacement
risks.effect: settings or sing-box config can become partial/corrupt and next startup behavior becomes ambiguous
risks.cause: MVP writes target files directly without temp+fsync+rename transaction
risks.mitigation: central atomic-write helper with temp file, fsync, rename and previous-good backup
risks.verification: fault-injection write tests prove either old or new complete file exists after interruption
